chemeleon_experiment.encoder: chemeleon_mp.pt from Zenodo record 15460715, md5 6a80b54fdb7de37ef0374d302f01e8ce (verified), 34,859,448 B
chemeleon_experiment.architecture: chemprop BondMessagePassing, d_h=2048, depth=6, d_v=72, d_e=14, no bias
chemeleon_experiment.usage: FROZEN featurizer with MeanAggregation; NOT fine-tuned
chemeleon_experiment.verdict: NEGATIVE. Frozen CheMeleon embeddings lose to ECFP4+RDKit-2D under both heads (+0.032 LGBM, +0.037 TabICL). Concatenating both also loses (0.7324 vs 0.7243).
chemeleon_experiment.one_exception: CYP2D6 under LightGBM improves 0.9796 -> 0.9472 (-0.032), the only winning cell
chemeleon_experiment.architecture_effect_reproduces: CheMeleon features: LGBM 0.7956 -> TabICL 0.7617 (-0.034), same direction as on ECFP4
chemeleon_experiment.limitation: rules out FROZEN embeddings as drop-in features, NOT fine-tuned CheMeleon. The organizers' own fine-tuned CheMeleon baseline scored 0.8335 on the leaderboard vs their TabICL 0.6755, which is stronger evidence that architecture beats representation here.

cyp2d6_investigation.hypothesis_1_assay_noise: REFUTED. CYP2D6 has the NARROWEST credible intervals of all four isoforms (median 0.272 overall, 0.261 above the floor) vs CYP2C9 0.526/0.432. Its noise-to-signal ratio (0.414) is mid-pack, better than CYP2C9 (0.729). It is not being scored against assay noise.
cyp2d6_investigation.hypothesis_2_orthogonal_sar: SUPPORTED, strongly. Mean off-diagonal Spearman with the other three isoforms is -0.002 for CYP2D6, vs +0.288 (CYP1A2), +0.330 (CYP2C9), +0.375 (CYP3A4). CYP2D6 potency is essentially uncorrelated with the rest.

pharmacophore_evidence.basic_nitrogen_is_the_only_positive_simp: rho +0.302 for CYP2D6; NEGATIVE for all three others (-0.098, -0.190, -0.119)
pharmacophore_evidence.lipophilicity_inert: logP rho +0.034 for CYP2D6 vs +0.602 for CYP3A4, +0.485 CYP2C9
pharmacophore_evidence.aromatic_count_inert: n_arom rho -0.001 for CYP2D6 vs +0.393 for CYP2C9 and CYP3A4
pharmacophore_evidence.dose_response: fraction potent (pIC50>=5) rises monotonically with basic-N count: 27.3% (n=935) -> 51.0% (n=522) -> 69.4% (n=36)

cyp2d6_investigation.distribution_shift: the blinded TEST set is DEPLETED in basic nitrogen: 11.6% of test compounds carry >=1 vs 18.9% of train. Mean count 0.123 vs 0.201.
cyp2d6_investigation.handbuilt_features_insufficient: 7 explicit pharmacophore features (basic-N count, quaternary N, bond-path distances to aromatic systems, logP, aromatic rings) score RAE 1.088 alone - WORSE than no-skill. The signal is real but weak and already captured by the full feature set (RAE 0.981).
cyp2d6_investigation.conclusion: CYP2D6's ceiling is a genuinely orthogonal, basicity-driven SAR that the shared feature family represents poorly - not assay noise, and not fixable with hand-built pharmacophore descriptors. The test-set basicity depletion means the small amount of basicity signal available is also less useful at test time.
actionable: train CYP2D6 separately rather than sharing representation (cross-isoform stacking helped it -0.017, but from a near-no-skill base)
CheMeleon's one win was CYP2D6 - a learned graph representation may capture what ECFP4 misses here; worth revisiting FINE-TUNED
consider protonation-state-aware or pKa-derived features rather than substructure counts
